title: Chelsea's 2012 final XI
brief: Name the ten outfield players who started for Chelsea against Bayern Munich in the 2012 Champions League final (19 May 2012), when they drew 1-1 and won on penalties. The goalkeeper (Petr Cech) is left out.

notes.Florent Malouda: Florent Malouda came on as a substitute in the 2012 final, so he did not start.
notes.Fernando Torres: Fernando Torres came on as a substitute in the 2012 final, so he did not start.
notes.John Terry: John Terry was suspended for the 2012 final.
notes.Branislav Ivanovic: Branislav Ivanovic was suspended for the 2012 final.
notes.Ramires: Ramires was suspended for the 2012 final.
notes.Raul Meireles: Raul Meireles was suspended for the 2012 final.

checks: Starting XI, positions and shirt numbers from the team sheet on the final's Wikipedia page; the same eleven players and shirt numbers are on the Transfermarkt match report. Positions are Wikipedia's.
